what: UAE and Hong Kong official trade with Russia reached with an ordinary headless browser (Playwright); see uae_hkg_r43-notes.md. Not used by the build yet.
fetch: pipeline/fetch/uae_hkg_r43.mjs, then pipeline/fetch/uae_hkg_r43_extract.py; extracts in research/2026-10/raw/uae_hkg_r43/

uae_fca_with_russia_2010_2019.source: UAE Open Data Portal (bayanat.ae), Federal Customs Authority, 'General Total Trade volume by country' 2010-2019 (dataset found by search; ids change per session)
uae_fca_with_russia_2010_2019.check: 2019 imports AED 10,262,485,242 / 3.6725 = USD 2,794.4 m, identical to IMF IMTS ARE MG_CIF_USD from RUS 2019 (2,794,413,952). IMTS therefore carries the UAE's own customs figures, so the IMTS series for 2022-2025 (8.19, 6.45, 6.53, 8.13) is the official UAE total

abu_dhabi_scad_non_oil.source: Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi, Non-oil Foreign Merchandise Trade Statistics Through Ports by Harmonized System (annual 2024, 2025; monthly 2026), Tables 7-8 (top 10 countries only). Abu Dhabi ports only; Dubai, where the gold trade is, is not covered
abu_dhabi_scad_non_oil.unit: AED million (USD million in brackets); 'lt' = Russia not in the top-10 table, below the 10th country's value

hong_kong_hs7108_from_russia_monthly_202.source: UN Comtrade public preview (Hong Kong = C&SD's own records), reporter 344, partner 643, flow M, monthly, one period per call
hong_kong_hs7108_from_russia_monthly_202.note: August and September 2026 not yet in Comtrade on 2026-10-24. The TOTAL rows equal those already in raw/comtrade_api/comtrade_monthly_2026_2026-10-23.json.gz; the HS 7108 split is new and confirms the build's 2026 HK_METALS_SHARE of 1.0 (carried from 2025)

not_reached.fcsc.gov.ae / uaestat.fcsc.gov.ae: Cloudflare block page ('Sorry, you have been blocked', HTTP 403) on an ordinary browser load; not retried
not_reached.www.economy.gov.ae: 502 upstream failure; the ministry now lives at moet.gov.ae (reachable; open-data page links back to bayanat.ae)
not_reached.www.dubaicustoms.gov.ae: reachable in the browser (curl gets a reset). Trade Statistics open-data page offers press-release cards (2013-2020, 2023), Dubai totals only, no partner-by-commodity tables
not_reached.tradeidds.censtatd.gov.hk: NOT requested: robots.txt 'User-agent: * Disallow: /'. This is the only C&SD source of country-by-commodity data after 2017 and of re-exports by origin
not_reached.C&SD annual supplements (B1020002 import: reachable, but the last edition is 2017
not_reached.C&SD Merchandise Trade Interactive Dashb: a Tableau Public embed (Trade_EN_PROD/TradeDashboard) that rendered blank in headless Chromium; it shows selected key statistics only
